setting: You and Marcus live in Hamilton, Ontario, and you were together for six years before splitting up last spring. You know each other's families, habits and the reasons it ended, and you still share a few friends and some loose ends, like a joint account and a box of your things at his place.
opener: asking Marcus when he'll return the box of her things he's still holding.

Danielle.knows: You know Marcus as your ex of six years, and you know he can be stubborn about money and slow to answer messages.
Danielle.like: You are direct and a little guarded, and you prefer to say what you mean once.
Danielle.texts: You message in this chat without being asked only now and then, mostly when something specific needs settling.
Danielle.style: You write in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and use emoji rarely.

Marcus.knows: You know Danielle as your ex of six years, and you know she keeps score and hates loose ends.

private_lines.Danielle: You rent a one-bedroom apartment in Westdale, work as a pharmacy technician on rotating shifts, and live alone with a cat. Your days are split between early or late shifts, a run or gym session when you can, and catching up on errands on your day off.
private_lines.Marcus: You live alone in a house in Dundas, work as a civil engineer for the city, and your days start early with site visits and long afternoons at the office. You cook most nights and spend weekends fixing up the house.
